'''Yatra''' is an Indian [[online travel agency]] and [[travel search engine]].

== History ==
Yatra.com was founded by Dhruv Shringi, Manish Amin and Sabina Chopra in August 2006.<ref name="BhanverBhanver2017">{{cite book|author1=Jagmohan Bhanver|author2=Komal Bhanver|title=CLICK!: The Amazing Story of India's E-commerce Boom and Where It's Headed|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=ZrjHDgAAQBAJ&pg=PT69|date=25 March 2017|publisher=Hachette India|isbn=978-93-5195-028-8|pages=69–|access-date=16 December 2020|archive-date=15 September 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200915140823/https://books.google.com/books?id=ZrjHDgAAQBAJ&pg=PT69|url-status=live}}</ref>

Early investors included Reliance Venture Asset Management Ltd,<ref>{{cite web |title=Our Portfolio |url=http://www.relianceventure.com/portfolio.html |publisher=[[Reliance Venture]] |access-date=2 May 2012 |archive-date=3 May 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120503164226/http://www.relianceventure.com/portfolio.html |url-status=live }}</ref> [[Web18]] of [[Network18 Group]] (a subsidiary of [[Reliance Industries]]), [[Norwest Venture Partners]] and [[Intel Capital]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.yatra.com/our-investors.html|title=Yatra Investors - Yatra.com|work=Yatra.com|access-date=3 February 2016|archive-date=6 June 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150606201139/http://www.yatra.com/our-investors.html|url-status=live}}</ref> In April 2011, it announced funding of {{INRConvert|2|b|mode=historical|year=2011|round=0}} from investors including Valiant Capital Management, [[Norwest Venture Partners]] (NVP) under Promod Haque's management and [[Intel Capital]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Yatra.com receives Rs 200 crores in funding to fuel growth |url=http://www.afaqs.com/news/company_briefs/index.html?id=48841_Yatra.com+receives+Rs+200+crores+in+funding+to+fuel+growth |publisher=afaqs |date=20 April 2011 |access-date=29 April 2012 |archive-date=25 September 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180925180711/http://www.afaqs.com/news/company_briefs/index.html?id=48841_Yatra.com%20receives%20Rs%20200%20crores%20in%20funding%20to%20fuel%20growth |url-status=dead }}</ref>

In April 2012, it became the second-largest online travel service in India, with a 30 percent share of online travel-related transactions.<ref>{{cite news |title=..two important stakeholders in online travel,.. |url=http://www.business-standard.com/india/news/are-online-travel-companies-gouging-customers/472495/ |publisher=[[Business Standard]] |date=25 April 2012 |access-date=2 May 2012 |archive-date=26 April 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120426091840/http://www.business-standard.com/india/news/are-online-travel-companies-gouging-customers/472495/ |url-status=live }}</ref> It launched “holiday-cum-shopping card” with [[State Bank of India]] (SBI).<ref>{{cite news |title=Yatra.Com launches holiday-cum-shopping credit card with SBI |url=http://www.business-standard.com/india/news/yatracom-launches-holiday-cum-shopping-credit-cardsbi/162133/on |publisher=BUsiness Standard |date=2 Apr 2012 |access-date=2 May 2012 |archive-date=9 May 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120509122442/http://business-standard.com/india/news/yatracom-launches-holiday-cum-shopping-credit-cardsbi/162133/on |url-status=live }}</ref>

In September 2013, Yatra.com suffered a data breach of more than 5 million users records, exposing email and physical addresses, dates of birth and phone numbers along with both PINs and passwords stored in plain text.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Have I Been Pwned: Pwned websites |url=https://haveibeenpwned.com/PwnedWebsites |access-date=2023-06-27 |website=[[haveibeenpwned.com]] |archive-date=3 October 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151003211856/https://haveibeenpwned.com/PwnedWebsites |url-status=live }}</ref>

In November 2013, Yatra.com launched e-gift cards in collaboration with [[Pine Labs#History|Qwikcilver]].<ref name="businessline">[http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/variety/yatracom-launches-egift-card/article5397916.ece "Yatra.com launches e-gift card"] The Hindu Business Line, 27 November 2013</ref> 

In December 2016, Yatra.com was publicly listed on the [[NASDAQ]] under the ticker symbol "YTRA".<ref>{{Cite web|date=2016-07-14|title=Yatra.com to list on NASDAQ via reverse merger with US-based blank cheque firm|url=https://www.vccircle.com/yatra-merge-nasdaq-listed-terrapin-3-acquisition|access-date=2021-10-07|website=VCCircle|language=en-US|archive-date=7 October 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211007060108/https://www.vccircle.com/yatra-merge-nasdaq-listed-terrapin-3-acquisition|url-status=live}}</ref>

In July 2019, [[Ebix]], a US-based company, planned to acquire Yatra.com<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/economy/logistics/us-based-ebix-buys-online-travel-portal-yatra/article28523118.ece|title=US-based Ebix buys online travel portal Yatra.com|website=@businessline|language=en|access-date=2019-07-18|archive-date=18 July 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190718040016/https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/economy/logistics/us-based-ebix-buys-online-travel-portal-yatra/article28523118.ece|url-status=live}}</ref> but the acquisition was cancelled in June 2020.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Yatra's failed merger with Ebix dents the company's earnings in an already troubled quarter|url=https://www.businessinsider.in/business/news/yatra-failed-merger-with-ebix-dents-the-companys-earnings-in-an-already-troubled-quarter/articleshow/78031342.cms|access-date=2021-10-07|website=Business Insider|archive-date=7 October 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211007060107/https://www.businessinsider.in/business/news/yatra-failed-merger-with-ebix-dents-the-companys-earnings-in-an-already-troubled-quarter/articleshow/78031342.cms|url-status=live}}</ref>

In June 2020, Yatra.com announced an underwritten public offering at $11.5 mn<ref name="Inc42 Media 2020">{{cite web | title=Yatra Closes $11.5 Mn Public Offering After Cancelling Ebix Merger | website=Inc42 Media | date=2020-06-25 | url=https://inc42.com/buzz/yatra-closes-11-5-mn-public-offering-after-cancelling-ebix-merger | language=la | access-date=2020-06-26 | archive-date=14 August 2020 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200814023827/https://inc42.com/buzz/yatra-closes-11-5-mn-public-offering-after-cancelling-ebix-merger/ | url-status=live }}</ref> and laid off about 400 employees around the same time.<ref name="Entrackr 2020">{{cite web | title=After fall out of the deal with Ebix, Yatra lays off 400 employees | website=Entrackr | date=2020-06-23 | url=https://entrackr.com/2020/06/yatra-lays-off-400-employees-covid-19/ | access-date=2020-06-26 | archive-date=28 June 2022 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220628122449/https://entrackr.com/2020/06/yatra-lays-off-400-employees-covid-19/ | url-status=live }}</ref>

In June 2021, Yatra collaborated with [[Oyo Rooms]], [[Airbnb]], and [[EaseMyTrip]] to form the [[Confederation of Hospitality, Technology and Tourism Industry]] (CHATT), an industry body for the tourism sector of India.<ref>{{Cite news|last=Alawadhi|first=Neha|date=2021-06-09|title=CHATT: New association announced, will help tourism, hospitality with tech|work=Business Standard India|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/economy-policy/new-association-announced-will-help-tourism-and-hospitality-with-tech-121060900576_1.html|access-date=2021-10-07|archive-date=7 October 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211007054302/https://www.business-standard.com/article/economy-policy/new-association-announced-will-help-tourism-and-hospitality-with-tech-121060900576_1.html|url-status=live}}</ref>

In 2023, Yatra Online listed on the Indian stock exchanges after its [[initial public offering]].<ref name="fy23">{{cite news |title=Yatra Online's IPO opens for subscription on September 15 |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/markets/ipo/yatra-onlines-ipo-opens-for-subscription-on-september-15/articleshow/103653973.cms |access-date=28 September 2023 |work=The Times of India |date=14 September 2023 |archive-date=18 September 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230918152523/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/markets/ipo/yatra-onlines-ipo-opens-for-subscription-on-september-15/articleshow/103653973.cms |url-status=live }}</ref>

== Acquisitions ==
Yatra acquired ticket consolidator Travel Services International (TSI) in October 2010,<ref>{{Cite news |date=2012-08-30 |title=Yatra.com to go for more acquisitions, aims Rs 7k crore revenue in next 5 years |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/services/travel/yatra-com-to-go-for-more-acquisitions-aims-rs-7k-crore-revenue-in-next-5-years/articleshow/15999673.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2024-09-08 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}}</ref> global distribution system provider Magicdom<ref>{{Cite web |title=Yatra Online Inc Share Price, YTRA Stock Price Quote Today |url=https://groww.in/us-stocks/ytra |access-date=2024-09-08 |website=Groww |language=en}}</ref> and Indian events and entertainment portal BuzzInTown.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=2012-01-09 |title=Yatra acquires events and entertainment portal Buzzintown.com |url=https://www.afaqs.com/news/digital/32692_yatra-acquires-events-and-entertainment-portal-buzzintowncom |access-date=2024-09-08 |website=afaqs! |language=en}}</ref> All were acquired for undisclosed amounts.<ref>[http://www.afaqs.com/news/story/32692_Yatra-acquires-events-and-entertainment-portal-Buzzintown.com Yatra acquires events and entertainment portal Buzzintown.com] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304142735/http://www.afaqs.com/news/story/32692_Yatra-acquires-events-and-entertainment-portal-Buzzintown.com |date=4 March 2016 }} afaqs.com.</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.exchange4media.com/44892_yatra-com-acquires-events-portal-buzzintown-com.html|title=Yatra.com acquires events portal Buzzintown.com|access-date=3 February 2016|archive-date=19 February 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140219014931/http://www.exchange4media.com/44892_yatra-com-acquires-events-portal-buzzintown-com.html|url-status=dead}}</ref> In July 2012, Yatra.com acquired a 100% stake in Travelguru.<ref name="afaqs!">{{cite web |title=Yatra.com acquires 100 percent stake in Travelguru |url=http://www.afaqs.com/news/story/34581_Yatracom-acquires-100-percent-stake-in-Travelguru |work=afaqs.com |publisher=afaqs! |location=Noida, India |date=2012-07-02 |access-date=2016-05-16 |author=afaqs! news bureau |archive-date=28 May 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160528161114/http://www.afaqs.com/news/story/34581_Yatracom-acquires-100-percent-stake-in-Travelguru |url-status=live }}</ref> In 2016, Yatra.com <ref>{{cite news |title=Lack Of Cash Flow, Demand For Refunds Hit Indian OTA Segment |url=https://inc42.com/buzz/lack-of-cash-flow-demand-for-refunds-hit-indian-ota-segment/ |work=Inc42 Media |date=12 May 2020 |access-date=19 May 2020 |archive-date=6 June 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200606205930/https://inc42.com/buzz/lack-of-cash-flow-demand-for-refunds-hit-indian-ota-segment/ |url-status=live }}</ref>  acquired-hired Mumbai-based Travel-logs.in, which specializes in customized city walks and private tours.<ref name="economictimes2">[http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2016-01-20/news/69931294_1_yatra-com-tours-travel-firm "Yatra acqui-hires travel-logs to boost tours within cities"] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160530152711/http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2016-01-20/news/69931294_1_yatra-com-tours-travel-firm |date=30 May 2016 }} The Economic Times, 20 January 2016</ref>

In September 2024, Yatra announced the acquisition of corporate travel company Globe Travels for {{INR}}128 crore.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.outlookbusiness.com/start-up/news/yatra-online-to-acquire-globe-travels-for-rs-128-crore-expanding-corporate-travel-reach |title=Yatra Online to Acquire Globe Travels for Rs 128 Crore, Expanding Corporate Travel Reach |work=Outlook |access-date=3 September 2024}}</ref>
